objectivesText: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

6163.name: Ramstein
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

6164.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
objectivesText: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

6181.name: A Swift Message
objectivesText: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

6182.name: The First and the Last
objectivesText: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.

6183.name: Honor the Dead
objectivesText: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

6184.name: Flint Shadowmore
objectivesText: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

6185.name: The Eastern Plagues
objectivesText: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

6186.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
objectivesText: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

6187.name: Order Must Be Restored
objectivesText: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.
Keep your wits about you, <Name>. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

6261.name: Dungar Longdrink
objectivesText: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

6281.name: Continue to Stormwind
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

6282.name: Harpies Threaten
objectivesText: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

6283.name: Bloodfury Bloodline
objectivesText: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

6284.name: Arachnophobia
objectivesText: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

6285.name: Return to Lewis
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

6301.name: Cycle of Rebirth
objectivesText: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

6321.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
objectivesText: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

6322.name: Michael Garrett
objectivesText: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

6323.name: Ride to the Undercity
objectivesText: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

6324.name: Return to Podrig
objectivesText: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

6341.name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
objectivesText: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.

6342.name: Flight to Auberdine
objectivesText: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.

6343.name: Return to Nessa
objectivesText: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

6344.name: Nessa Shadowsong
objectivesText: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

6361.name: A Bundle of Hides
objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

6362.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

6363.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
objectivesText: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

6364.name: Return to Jahan
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

6365.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
objectivesText: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

6381.name: New Life
objectivesText: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

6382.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
objectivesText: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

6384.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

6385.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
objectivesText: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

6386.name: Return to the Crossroads.
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

6387.name: Honor Students
objectivesText: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

6388.name: Gryth Thurden
objectivesText: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

6389.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

6390.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

6391.name: Ride to Ironforge
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

6392.name: Return to Brock
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

6393.name: Elemental War
objectivesText: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

6394.name: Thazz'ril's Pick
objectivesText: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

6395.name: Marla's Last Wish
objectivesText: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

6401.name: Kaya's Alive
objectivesText: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
objectivesText: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

6403.name: The Great Masquerade
objectivesText: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

6421.name: Boulderslide Ravine
objectivesText: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

6441.name: Satyr Horns
objectivesText: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

6442.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
objectivesText: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

6461.name: Blood Feeders
objectivesText: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

6462.name: Troll Charm
objectivesText: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

6481.name: Earthen Arise
objectivesText: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

6482.name: Freedom to Ruul
objectivesText: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.

6501.name: The Dragon's Eye
objectivesText: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

6502.name: Drakefire Amulet
objectivesText: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

6503.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
objectivesText: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

6504.name: The Lost Pages
objectivesText: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

6521.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectivesText: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6522.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectivesText: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6523.name: Protect Kaya
objectivesText: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6541.name: Report to Kadrak
objectivesText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6542.name: Report to Kadrak
objectivesText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6543.name: The Warsong Reports
objectivesText: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

6544.name: Torek's Assault
objectivesText: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

6548.name: Avenge My Village
objectivesText: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6561.name: Blackfathom Villainy
objectivesText: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

6562.name: Trouble in the Deeps
objectivesText: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6563.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
objectivesText: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6564.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectivesText: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6565.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectivesText: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6566.name: What the Wind Carries
objectivesText: Listen to Thrall.

6567.name: The Champion of the Horde
objectivesText: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

6568.name: The Testament of Rexxar
objectivesText: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

6569.name: Oculus Illusions
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

6570.name: Emberstrife
objectivesText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

6571.name: Warsong Supplies
objectivesText: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

6582.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
objectivesText: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

6583.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
objectivesText: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

6584.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
objectivesText: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

6585.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
objectivesText: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

6601.name: Ascension...
objectivesText: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

6602.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

6603.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
objectivesText: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

6604.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

6605.name: A Strange One
objectivesText: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

6606.name: A Little Luck
objectivesText: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

6607.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objectivesText: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

places.name: Misty Reed Mahi Mahi Fishing Location
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin Fishing Location

6608.name: You Too Good.
objectivesText: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

6609.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
objectivesText: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

6610.name: Clamlette Surprise
objectivesText: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

6611.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
objectivesText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6612.name: I Know A Guy...
objectivesText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6621.name: King of the Foulweald
objectivesText: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

6622.name: Triage
objectivesText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6623.name: Horde Trauma
objectivesText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

6624.name: Triage
objectivesText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6625.name: Alliance Trauma
objectivesText: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.

6626.name: A Host of Evil
objectivesText: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

6627.name: Test of Lore
objectivesText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

6628.name: Test of Lore
objectivesText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

6629.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
objectivesText: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6641.name: Vorsha the Lasher
objectivesText: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

6642.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore

6643.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core

6644.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core

6645.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather

6646.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain

6661.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
objectivesText: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

6662.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
objectivesText: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

6681.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
objectivesText: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.
Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

6721.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6722.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6761.name: The New Frontier
objectivesText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

6762.name: Rabine Saturna
objectivesText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

6804.name: Poisoned Water
objectivesText: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
objectivesText: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.name: Eye of the Emberseer
objectivesText: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.name: The Molten Core
objectivesText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
objectivesText: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6824.name: Hands of the Enemy
objectivesText: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6844.name: Umber, Archivist
objectivesText: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6845.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
objectivesText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6847.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
objectivesText: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6848.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
objectivesText: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6921.name: Amongst the Ruins
objectivesText: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6922.name: Baron Aquanis
objectivesText: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6961.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

6962.name: Treats for Great-father Winter
objectivesText: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

6963.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

6964.name: The Reason for the Season
objectivesText: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.

6981.name: The Glowing Shard
objectivesText: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

6982.name: Coldtooth Supplies
objectivesText: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

6983.name: You're a Mean One...
objectivesText: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

6984.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
objectivesText: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.

6985.name: Irondeep Supplies
objectivesText: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

7001.name: Empty Stables
objectivesText: Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

7003.name: Zapped Giants
objectivesText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7021.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

7022.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

7023.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

7024.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

7025.name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
objectivesText: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

7027.name: Empty Stables
objectivesText: Locate an Alterac Ram in Alterac Valley. Use the Stormpike Training Collar when you are near the Alterac Ram to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Alterac Ram will follow you back to the Stable Master. Speak with the Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

7028.name: Twisted Evils
objectivesText: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

7029.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objectivesText: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

7041.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objectivesText: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

7042.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

7043.name: You're a Mean One...
objectivesText: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

7044.name: Legends of Maraudon
objectivesText: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.

7045.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

7046.name: The Scepter of Celebras
objectivesText: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

7061.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
objectivesText: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

7062.name: The Reason for the Season
objectivesText: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.

7063.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
objectivesText: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

7064.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectivesText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

7065.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectivesText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

7066.name: Seed of Life
objectivesText: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

7067.name: The Pariah's Instructions
objectivesText: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

7068.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectivesText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

7070.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectivesText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

7081.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
objectivesText: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7082.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
objectivesText: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7101.name: Towers and Bunkers
objectivesText: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7102.name: Towers and Bunkers
objectivesText: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7121.name: The Quartermaster
objectivesText: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

7122.name: Capture a Mine
objectivesText: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7123.name: Speak with our Quartermaster
objectivesText: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.

7124.name: Capture a Mine
objectivesText: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7141.name: The Battle of Alterac
objectivesText: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

7142.name: The Battle for Alterac
objectivesText: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

7161.name: Proving Grounds
objectivesText: Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

7162.name: Proving Grounds
objectivesText: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7181.name: The Legend of Korrak
objectivesText: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

7201.name: The Last Element
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

7202.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
objectivesText: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7221.name: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer
objectivesText: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.

7222.name: Speak with Voggah Deathgrip
objectivesText: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

7223.name: Armor Scraps
objectivesText: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

7224.name: Enemy Booty
objectivesText: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

7241.name: In Defense of Frostwolf
objectivesText: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

7261.name: The Sovereign Imperative
objectivesText: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!

7281.name: Brotherly Love
objectivesText: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

7282.name: Brotherly Love
objectivesText: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.

7301.name: Fallen Sky Lords
objectivesText: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

7302.name: Fallen Sky Lords
objectivesText: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

7321.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
objectivesText: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

7361.name: Favor Amongst the Darkspear
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing night elf players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a night elf and return to Najak Hexxen at Frostwolf Keep with a Severed Night Elf Head.

7362.name: Ally of the Tauren
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.

7363.name: The Human Condition
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing human players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and Frostwolf keep) with a Human Bone Chip.
A cure for the human condition is close at hand!

7364.name: Gnomeregan Bounty
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.

7365.name: Staghelm's Requiem
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing troll players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a troll and return to Athramanis at Dun'Baldar with Darkspear Troll Mojo.

7366.name: The Archbishop's Mercy
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.

7367.name: Defusing the Threat
objectivesText: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

7368.name: Defusing the Threat
objectivesText: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Frostwolf Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

7381.name: The Return of Korrak
objectivesText: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Warmaster Laggrond in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

7382.name: Korrak the Everliving
objectivesText: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

7383.name: Crown of the Earth
objectivesText: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

7401.name: Wanted: DWARVES!
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at Frostwolf Keep.

7402.name: Wanted: ORCS!
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley.
Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

7423.name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips

7441.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

7461.name: The Madness Within
objectivesText: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

7462.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
objectivesText: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

7463.name: Arcane Refreshment
objectivesText: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

7481.name: Elven Legends
objectivesText: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

7482.name: Elven Legends
objectivesText: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

7483.name: Libram of Rapidity
objectivesText: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.

7484.name: Libram of Focus
objectivesText: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.

7485.name: Libram of Protection
objectivesText: Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.

7486.name: A Hero's Reward
objectivesText: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.

7488.name: Lethtendris's Web
objectivesText: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7489.name: Lethtendris's Web
objectivesText: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

7490.name: Victory for the Horde
objectivesText: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

7491.name: For All To See
objectivesText: Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.

7492.name: Camp Mojache
objectivesText: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

7494.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
objectivesText: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7495.name: Victory for the Alliance
objectivesText: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7496.name: Celebrating Good Times
objectivesText: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.

7498.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7499.name: Codex of Defense
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7500.name: The Arcanist's Cookbook
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7501.name: The Light and How To Swing It
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7502.name: Harnessing Shadows
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7503.name: The Greatest Race of Hunters
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7504.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7505.name: Frost Shock and You
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7506.name: The Emerald Dream...
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7507.name: Nostro's Compendium
objectivesText: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

7508.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objectivesText: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

places.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

startedBy.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

7509.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objectivesText: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.
The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.
Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

7562.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
objectivesText: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7563.name: Rage of Blood
objectivesText: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7564.name: Wildeyes
objectivesText: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7581.name: The Prison's Bindings
objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

7582.name: The Prison's Casing
objectivesText: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

7583.name: Suppression
objectivesText: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.

7601.name: What Niby Commands
objectivesText: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

7602.name: Flawless Fel Essence
objectivesText: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.

7603.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
objectivesText: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

7604.name: A Binding Contract
objectivesText: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

7622.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
objectivesText: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

places.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow

triggerEnd.text: The Balance of Light and Shadow

7623.name: Lord Banehollow
objectivesText: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

7624.name: Ulathek the Traitor
objectivesText: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

7625.name: Xorothian Stardust
objectivesText: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7626.name: Bell of Dethmoora
objectivesText: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7627.name: Wheel of the Black March
objectivesText: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7628.name: Doomsday Candle
objectivesText: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7629.name: Imp Delivery
objectivesText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

7630.name: Arcanite
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7631.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
objectivesText: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
objectivesText: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <Name>; It's a big world.

7634.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
objectivesText: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

7635.name: A Proper String
objectivesText: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

7636.name: Stave of the Ancients
objectivesText: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
Simone the Seductress.
Klinfran the Crazed.
Solenor the Slayer.
Artorius the Doombringer.
Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.
Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
You MUST complete this task by yourself.
